in_marathi.name: Singham
in_marathi.long_meaning: Singham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word Singh meaning 'lion'. Singham is a powerful name that symbolizes strength and courage. It is believed to bring victory and success in life.
